title: The Stone and the Mole
lines: Rose digs a hole at home.
A big stone is stuck in it.
"We can tug it up," said Mom.
She gets a rope and a long pole.
They tug and tug and the stone pops up.
A mole hops up with a wet nose!
"That was my home," said the mole.
So Rose and Mom set the stone back.

questions.ask: What does Mom get to help tug the stone?
questions.listenFor: A rope and a pole. If they name just one, ask "and what else did she get?" and send them back to the line.

questions.ask: Who was living under the stone?
questions.listenFor: A mole. It says so in the story, so point at the line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why do you think Rose and Mom set the stone back? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason is right. Listen for something like "so the mole gets his home back."
